notes: sheet: no accepted reference sheet yet - the founder explicitly approved modelling from the DRAFT generated/draft-sheet.png (same sheet Tripo multiview was run from). Codex's review: both side cameras sit slightly high, so the side silhouette may overstate the height

carBox / wheels: measured on 3-4x ruler crops of the pack photo. Tail (bumper) x 298, nose x ~1362, roof y 249, tyres bottom y ~523-525. The toy sits in the blister with its bonnet tilted OPEN (up to y ~165); the box starts at y 240 so most of the raised bonnet stays out. Tyres r ~70 around rims r ~58: rear (576, 453), front (1188, 455)

mask (photo px, 2x ruler crops): the segmenter took the blister above the car and the toy's raised front clam (bonnet hinged open, up to y ~165). remove cuts everything above the closed-car profile (tail 290,375 - roof 700,249 - windscreen base 880,338 - nose 1372,455); add fills the closed bonnet/front fenders (cowl y ~338 falling to the nose, down to the front arch and sills) so the landing fits the closed-bonnet model the sheet draws. The add is an estimate of the closed shape, not seen in the photo

model.rebake.glass: front/rear/top traced on the mesh (4-5x ruler crops of tripo-sheet/tripo-clay), one half each and mirrored. The sheet's own masks spilled: on the front and rear onto the roof edge and onto the wing mirrors, in the top over the roof header, the cowl and the sills. front: windscreen inside the chrome frame, stopping above the bonnet's power bulge (x>225 below y 1227); rear: the rounded hatch glass inside its chrome surround; top: windscreen (x 480-560) and the rear hatch glass (x 133-262). side/left are left out: Tripo modelled the door/quarter windows as open holes (nothing to paint)

model.fit height 0.94: the draft sheet's side cameras sit high (Codex review), so its side silhouette overstates height and the fit stretched Tripo's mesh to it. Three checks agree it is ~6% too tall: (1) the spinning wheels came out oval, 0.651 tall x 0.613 long (front) and 0.657 x 0.615 (rear) - 0.94 makes them round; (2) roof height / length was 0.296 against 0.274 for a real Series 1 FHC (1219/4453 mm); (3) the pack photo's toy is ~0.26 (275 px roof-to-tyre over 1067 px). Front/rear drawings are elevated too and can't arbitrate. Consequence: size vs sheet height ~0.91 and the side IoU fall below their gates - expected, the gate measures against the draft sheet's inflated side view

model.rebake.trust rear x 720-822, y 1236-1293 (mesh px, between the tail lights above the plate): the drawing's JAGUAR script came out as Tripo's garbled blobby lettering (the agreement test kept Tripo's paint); the aligned drawing wins there and lands its JAGUAR just above the plate. model.rebake.flat rear x 726-816, y 1240-1266: Tripo had also embossed that invented lettering into the normal map

checks (promote): side_iou 0.856, left_iou 0.874 and height_within_5%_of_sheet (0.913) fail by design after model.fit height 0.94 - see that note. Without the fit the side IoU was already 0.928 (< 0.93): the draft draws the car slightly nose-down (front tyre bottoms 13-15 px lower than the rear in both side views). Landing IoU 0.847 (0.836 before the fit, stretch 1.107 -> 1.073): the toy sits in the blister with its front clam open, which the closed model can't match; the raised clam stays visible behind the landed model
